paragraphs: Hi, I'm **Miro** and I create websites and web applications. I handle the whole process from visual design and the user interface to the backend and a working website.

With an eye for detail, I combine colors, shapes, code, and empty space into a whole that works well, looks pleasant, and feels natural to use. I enjoy finding calm in complexity and bringing the essential parts forward.
I work with React on the frontend and Python and its web frameworks on the backend. You can explore my work in the [projects section](/projects)

contact.intro: I will be glad to hear from you with a question, an idea, or a specific request. If you are looking for someone to build a website, an app, or improve an existing solution, feel free to write. Together we can go through what you need and what the next step should be.

projects.title: Priatelu
projects.description: Priatelu connects people nearby through shared interests. It helps them find companions for conversations, trips, and activities. I built the app independently, from visual design to frontend and backend.

images.alt: Priatelu: discovering people nearby with profiles, interests, and connection options
Priatelu: sample profile with a bio, interests, and photo gallery
Priatelu: editing your profile, photos, location, and interests
Priatelu: two-way conversation with Nina with message contents hidden

features: Create and edit a profile with photos, a bio, and interests.
Discover people by city, distance, age, and gender.
Connect after a mutual like and start chatting.

projects.title: Digital archive
projects.description: Digital archive keeps documents organized. I focused mainly on the React frontend and API integration. The [demo](https://archive.wondercules.com) uses sample data and accepts any login credentials.

images.alt: Document overview in the digital archive
Adding a new document to the digital archive
Filtering documents by category
Managing categories in the digital archive

features: Add and organize documents into categories you can manage.
Filter documents by category, author, or approver.
Approve documents across multiple levels and track their status.

projects.title: Yokaid
projects.description: Yokaid helps people find local professionals through reviews. Shared experiences make it easier to choose a tradesperson or service provider. I built the project independently, from visual design to a working app.

images.alt: Map with professionals in the Yokaid app
Professional profile with ratings and reviews
Form for writing a review of a professional
Searching professionals by name

features: Discover local professionals on a map and search by name.
View profiles with ratings and reviews from other users.
Add your own reviews and share experiences with professionals.

projects.title: Aikido Levice
projects.description: The Aikido Levice website introduces the club and the martial art. It keeps newcomers and members informed about training schedules and club news. I built the website independently, from visual design to implementation.

images.alt: Introduction to Aikido and club news
Aikido Dojo Levice club news and gallery
Aikido Dojo Levice photo gallery and training schedule
Aikido Dojo Levice training schedule and instructors

features: Training schedules for children and adults, plus instructor profiles.
Information about Aikido, club news, and training photo galleries.
A contact form for questions and training enquiries.

projects.title: Wake Up Neo
projects.description: Wake Up Neo adds a pause before distracting websites. It gives you time to consider your intention instead of opening a page out of habit. No account is needed; settings stay on your device and answers are not stored.

images.alt: Wake Up Neo: a question about the intention to visit Facebook and PIN entry on a shuffled keypad
Wake Up Neo: language selection, answer requirement, and a custom question before visiting a website
Wake Up Neo: managing monitored domains with Facebook, a custom display name, and controls to add or remove a domain
Wake Up Neo: selecting authenticator app verification and setting up TOTP with a QR code or text key

features: Choose distracting websites, including subdomains and custom display names.
Set a custom question before visits and optionally require an answer of at least five words.
Confirm with a PIN on a shuffled keypad or a TOTP code; available in Slovak and English.
